clips.send: A friend sends this to someone cutting carbs who never thought to check where the corn syrup in their snacks comes from - anger at realizing the corn was bred to fatten cattle fast, not people.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says almost all the corn grown in America today comes from Monsanto seed, bred specifically to fatten cattle fast.

His point: that's the exact corn turning up in corn syrup, corn starch and corn meal on your own ingredient labels. He says if it fattens a cow quickly, it isn't doing anything different inside a person.

His test at the grocery store: read the label, and if the word "corn" shows up more than once, put it back on the shelf.

How many times does the word "corn" show up on what's in your pantry right now?

#kevintrudeau #corn #monsanto #readthelabel #wholefood #foodtruth

clips.send: A friend sends this to the coworker who swears by diet soda for weight loss - anger at realizing the "no calories" choice is the one that packs on weight.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once compared two people on his show: one drinking regular Coca-Cola with real sugar, the other drinking the diet version with aspartame instead.

The diet drinker took in far fewer calories every day. After 30 days, Kevin says it was the diet drinker who gained weight.

His explanation: artificial sweeteners affect the serotonin levels in your brain, and he says they end up making you hungrier, not less.

So the "no calories" label isn't the whole story. Next time you reach for the diet can, what are you really trading the sugar for?

#kevintrudeau #dietsoda #aspartame #readthelabel #wholefood #healthtruth

clips.start_words: A pig eats its own feces
clips.send: A friend sends this to the family that does bacon every Sunday - anxiety at learning pork can take twice as long to digest as most meat.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau grew up Italian, with pork chops and sausage on the table every week. He didn't give it up overnight.

His point on the show: a pig will eat almost anything in its path, and whatever it eats turns to meat on its bones. He says pork can take about 48 hours to digest, longer than most meat, which he calls a heavier load on the body.

After a few months without it, Kevin says his own energy and mental clarity went up.

Would you notice a difference after 48 hours, or only after a few months?

#kevintrudeau #pork #digestion #wholefood #healthtruth #foodfacts

clips.start_words: More people get sick from eating
clips.send: A mom sends this to her sister who orders the seafood platter every Friday - anxiety at learning shellfish filter whatever is in the water, toxins included.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau grew up in Boston eating the Friday fisherman's platter: fried clams, scallops, shrimp, the works.

His warning years later: shellfish like clams, mussels and lobster are filters. Whatever is in the water, they keep in their flesh, including a toxic algae bloom called red tide. That's one reason, he says, more people get sick from bad shellfish than from any other food group.

His rule of thumb: stick to fish with scales and fins, like cod, haddock or mackerel. He says they filter the toxins out before the fish ever reaches the plate.

Does your go-to seafood order pass that test?

#kevintrudeau #shellfish #redtide #seafoodsafety #readthelabel #healthtruth

clips.end_words: stay away from trans fats and hydrogenated oil
clips.send: A friend sends this to whoever just bought peanut butter without flipping the jar over - anxiety at learning what hydrogenated oil does once it's inside you.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to one word on a label: hydrogenated. That's the sign of a trans fat.

His claim on the show: hydrogenated oils affect your arteries and your hormones, and he says they raise your appetite the same way some artificial sweeteners do, which is why the two often show up together in packaged snacks.

His fix: skip anything listing hydrogenated oil, and look for one made with real olive, avocado or coconut oil instead.

Have you checked your own pantry for the word "hydrogenated" yet?

#kevintrudeau #transfats #hydrogenatedoil #readthelabel #wholefood #healthtruth

clips.start_words: monosodium glutamate, also known as MSG
clips.end_words: because they know what this stuff does
clips.send: A friend sends this to whoever is mid-bag of Doritos right now - anger at realizing the ingredient is printed right there, in plain sight.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells viewers to flip over a bag of Doritos Nacho Cheese and read the ingredient list out loud.

Right there, in plain print: monosodium glutamate, MSG. He says it's in the same family as artificial sweeteners, an excitotoxin, and that it can make you hungrier and thirstier, so you keep reaching back into the bag.

His rule: if a label lists it plainly, at least you know what you're choosing to eat.

What's the last ingredient label you actually read all the way through?

#kevintrudeau #msg #doritos #readthelabel #foodtruth #wholefood

clips.send: A friend sends this to whoever always feels bloated after pasta night - awe at discovering it may be the 8-hour wheat, not the gluten.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the high-gluten wheat grown in America and Canada is often fermented for only about 8 hours before it's milled into flour.

His fix: he shops for bread and pasta labeled "Product of Italy." He says that wheat is traditionally fermented for 48 hours, with nothing genetically modified and no hybrid seed.

His test at Whole Foods: he picks the crostini that names Italy as the country of origin, checks for durum wheat on the label, and skips the rest.

Next time you're at the store, does your bread name where the wheat actually came from?

#kevintrudeau #wheat #glutenfacts #readthelabel #wholefood #healthtruth

clips.start_words: Almost all soy now comes from Monsanto seed
clips.send: A friend sends this to whoever buys "organic" salad dressing without checking the oil - anger at the cheap soybean oil hiding behind the organic label.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says almost all the soy sold in America and Canada now comes from genetically modified Monsanto seed, and that it can lower testosterone levels.

His example: organic soybean oil on a salad dressing label. His point is simple - nobody makes real vinaigrette at home with soybean oil, they reach for extra virgin olive oil. So if a bottle leans on soybean oil instead, he says that's the cheap ingredient talking, not the good one.

His fix: skip the soybean oil, reach for extra virgin olive oil instead.

Next time you flip a salad dressing bottle, which oil is actually in it?

#kevintrudeau #soy #testosterone #oliveoil #readthelabel #healthtruth
